summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime from GitHub and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload at npm install
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/..., extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB bundle carrying obfuscator.io fingerprints (string-array rotation routine performing push(shift()) on a large mixed literal table, hex-suffixed identifiers, thousands of indirect lookups) and is not part of the ~2KB React console.error filter this package advertises. math_init.js sits at the tarball root but is not declared in package.json files[] (which lists only dist and src), so it is a smuggled payload rather than published source. The package name @servicetitan/suppress-warnings uses a scope that resembles ServiceTitan's org while the payload has no relationship to that org's uikit repo. Using an alternate JavaScript runtime fetched at install time executes code outside the Node module graph, evading Node-based scanners, and the executed content is obfuscated and unrelated to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
